data.standardized_narrative: The report discloses gross claims outstanding (closing balance at 31 Dec 2017) of approximately GBP 400.0m. I could not find an explicit GROSS prior-year movement (reestimation of years prior to 2017) stated as a single gross amount in the notes or narrative. A claims development table is present in the notes but a reliable, unambiguous gross prioryear movement was not extractable from the scanned pages provided, so no prior year strengthening/release amount is reported here.
data.data_quality_notes: Document provided as scanned images. I located a gross claims development table and the balance-sheet style totals; the closing gross claims outstanding at 31 Dec 2017 was inferred as GBP 400,013,527 (used above as opening reserves for 2018) from the claims development / notes table (printed page 38). I could not find a clearly labelled GROSS 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' figure in the scanned pages, nor an explicit sentence stating the GROSS prior year release/strengthening. The claims development triangle is present but, due to scan quality and layout, I did not extract individual development-cell values to calculate a PYD total reliably. Where numbers were read they appear to be shown in full GBP (not scaled). If you can provide higher-resolution pages of the Technical Reserves notes (claims development table and the 'movement in prior year's provision' note), I can compute the prior-year development precisely. Fields left null reflect data not unambiguously found in the supplied images.
